items.title: Don't expect a GTA set outside the USA anytime soon, as Rockstar has "not had a lot of conversations over doing it anywhere else"
items.en_title: Don't expect a GTA set outside the USA anytime soon, as Rockstar has "not had a lot of conversations over doing it anywhere else"
